title: Disable HPET
name: disable-hpet
description: Disables High Precision Event Timer to fix micro-stutter in games.
deepDescription: Disables the High Precision Event Timer (HPET) via bcdedit and disables dynamic tick. HPET can cause micro-stutter and frame pacing issues in games like Valorant, CS2, and others. This forces the system to use the more efficient TSC timer source.
